column1: # vm-unversioned-manifest.tsv — the payloads GIT CANNOT DELIVER to a Lupin VM.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
#   `push-bundle` / GitHub sync carry COMMITTED, NON-IGNORED content only. Everything
#   below is gitignored (secrets, personal data, VM-local config, or too large), so a
#   fresh VM rediscovers each member BY FAILING. On 2026-07-25 that happened three
#   times in one day: a missing `contact-information.map` made EVERY transcription 500.
#   This category used to live in somebody's head. Now it is data.
# CONSUMERS
#   - src/scripts/preflight-vm.sh    check B3 — asserts each REQUIRED path is present
#                                    with the expected owner/mode on the VM.
#   - src/scripts/lupin-vm.sh        push-unversioned — ships each path from the dev
#                                    box to the VM.
# FORMAT — tab-separated, 5 columns. '#' comments and blank lines ignored.
#   local_path      path relative to the dev-box repo root, or an absolute path.
#                   A trailing '/' means "directory, recurse".
#   remote_path     absolute path on the VM.
#   owner           expected numeric uid:gid on the VM ('-' = do not assert).
#   mode            expected octal mode ('-' = do not assert). For a directory entry
#                   this is asserted on the FILES inside, not the dir itself.
#   requirement     REQUIRED — preflight BLOCKS when absent.
#                   OPTIONAL — preflight WARNs when absent (large/situational payloads).
# ADDING AN ENTRY
#   Add the row here — do NOT hardcode a path in the script. If a payload is required
#   for the app to start, mark it REQUIRED so a fresh VM fails loudly at preflight
#   instead of quietly at 3am.
# local_path
# --- provider / notification keys (gitignored: secrets) ------------------------
src/conf/keys/
# --- personalization map (gitignored: personal data; .gitignore:65) ------------
# Absent => MultiModalMunger loads 4 of 5 .map files and every transcription 500s.
# Code fix e1b48afa makes it OPTIONAL at load and REFUSES LOUDLY at use, so its
# absence is now a named failure rather than a silent "N/A" answer — but the file
# still has to get there, and only this manifest says so.
src/conf/contact-information.map
# --- VM-local compose env (gitignored: VM-specific, hand-edited in place) ------
# NOT shipped from dev — the values are VM-correct and would be clobbered by a copy.
# Listed so preflight ASSERTS ITS PRESENCE; push-unversioned SKIPS it (local_path '-').
# --- portable Claude Code permission stanza (NOT in any repo, by ruling) -------
# Rick 2026-08-04: "I do not want this file in the repo ... put it outside of the project's
# directory in the projects data directory." So it lives at $DEEPILY_DATA_DIR and git cannot
# carry it — which is precisely this manifest's category.
# Absent => every Claude Code session on the VM stops to ask permission for routine work,
# because the VM's settings.json lacks the bare tool names ("Bash", "Read" — no parentheses,
# therefore path-free) that the dev box grants.
# SHIPPING IT IS HALF THE JOB: it is a SOURCE file, not a live settings file. Applying it is
# `python3 $LUPIN_ROOT/src/scripts/apply_claude_permissions.py`, which MERGES the stanza into
# ~/.claude/settings.json and leaves that file's machine-specific hooks/env/model keys alone.
# Owner is the VM LOGIN user (not 1001) — Claude Code reads it as that user.
/mnt/DATA01/include/www.deepily.ai/projects-data/claude-permissions.json
# --- large out-of-band corpora (gitignored: size) ------------------------------
# Shipped by tar.gz + scp, not by this verb; listed so preflight can report on them.
